# Bridgepoint Freight & Logistics - GitHub Configuration\n\n## Repository Settings\n\nThis file documents the recommended GitHub repository configuration.\n\n### Branch Protection Rules\n\n**For `main` branch:**\n- Require pull request reviews before merging (1 reviewer)\n- Require status checks to pass before merging\n- Require branches to be up to date before merging\n- Include administrators in restrictions\n\n### Labels\n\n- `bug`: Something isn't working\n- `enhancement`: New feature or request\n- `documentation`: Improvements or additions to documentation\n- `good first issue`: Good for newcomers\n- `help wanted`: Extra attention is needed\n- `question`: Further information is requested\n- `wontfix`: This will not be worked on\n- `priority: high`: High priority issue\n- `priority: low`: Low priority issue\n\n### Milestones\n\n- v1.1.0 - Blog & Blog Integration\n- v1.2.0 - Team Profiles & About Page\n- v1.3.0 - CRM Integration\n- v2.0.0 - Major Feature Release\n\n### Workflows\n\n- GitHub Actions for CI/CD (to be implemented)\n- Automated dependency updates\n- Code quality checks\n\n---\n\n**Last Updated**: July 2024\n
